    The quotient construction satisfies the hypotheses of Theorem 5.2 #

    For Q : QuotientData k Λ with one-dimensional tops at e_x, e_y and J^n = 0, the functor F₁ : D → Mod Λ of Construction 3.3 is exact and faithful, has finite-dimensional values on D_fin and satisfies the colimit comparison (3.6) (Lemma 3.4); its retractions on D (Proposition 4.1) restrict to C. Restricted to D_fin, the retractions show that F₁(S₋) is indecomposable and not isomorphic to F₁(T) for T ∈ C_fin.
